project.title: DriftTrace — calibration failure impact tracing
project.short_description: When a measuring instrument fails calibration, DriftTrace uses LangChain + Gemini to extract the notice with verbatim source quotes, then traces the instrument through IBM Db2 to the inspections, lots and shipments that need review, with a reason for every record, illustrative error-bound sensitivity, and a transactionally saved, auditable investigation case.

members.name: Noah Stiggins
members.role: Solo developer — Db2, AI and UI

features_used: Relational Tables (8) with Primary/Foreign Keys and CHECK Constraints
Aggregate View (DT_LOT_EXPOSURE_V) used as an in-database cross-check
Triggers enforcing append-only cases, findings, audit and review history
Least-privilege GRANTs for a dedicated application user
SYSCAT Catalog Queries for Idempotent Migrations
